input_access_statement: Reviewed only cases.json, application-contract.md, flow-contract.md, packet-receipt.json and supplied sources within the designated packet directory. Verified every receipt-listed SHA-256 by reading those packet files. Did not consult author labels, repository docs/history, prior experiments, other agent outputs or network; did not run an analyzer or execute/import source projects. Used Python -B only for packet reading, digest verification and output serialization. The initial rtk exec invocation failed without reading inputs; subsequent shell commands used rtk python3 -B. Labels are independent source-and-contract judgments, not human gold or runtime validation. Snapshot import roots were taken from cases.json.

contract_findings.finding: Assert is omitted from both the permitted-intervening-statement list and the named barrier list. The closed-subset interpretation makes it unresolved, but this should be explicit; assertion success is not an if-candidate link.

The final paragraph groups nested assignments, chained assignments and other forms as unresolved or outside the immediate-identifier inventory without assigning each form to one outcome. I retain simple identifier assignments nested in loops as inventory rows with unresolved scope, following the earlier definition that examined_bindings counts immediate single-identifier assignments.

Visible local FirstMatch constructors and type annotations do not qualify under this module-constant-only contract. Labeling them direct or mixed would silently expand receiver resolution. Unsupported means unresolved, not absent.

Only the binding-error example supplies a supported branch link. Later enum comparison or callable invocation does not change a direct assignment call into mixed consumption; a conditional-expression RHS is mixed and supplies no immediate call/projection binding.

A non-Specification decide method remains syntactically inventoried as unresolved_call and its immediate binding unresolved. The six ordinary Flask/FastAPI snippets instead have no decide call and are absent/outside_api.
